items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And at this time I met a pianist who played so much like Art Tatum, his name was Willie Hawkins.

ctx.x: Do you know what label? Capitol?

It was Capitol, yeah, yeah. I also want to go back to Detroit, we were talking about Gerald Wilson (up there) when we picked him didn't we. And at this time I met a pianist who played so much like Art Tatum, his name was Willie Hawkins. And he finally came out here but he got ill and he went back to Detroit, and I think he died. And this is where I met Al McKibbon, during that same time, and we got Gerald Wilson out of there.
